rationale: High energy, precise, command-center feel specifically catering to athlete recovery, mimicking Whoop and Bevel with a dark neon aesthetic.

charts.style: minimalist, hidden grid lines, thick neon stroke colors mapping to metrics

icons.usage: Use consistently for tab bar, metric icons, and settings. No emojis.

testing.rules: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and key metric cards MUST have a data-testid attribute for automated testing. Example: data-testid='recovery-score-card'

onboarding.layout: Full-screen background image with dark overlay, text at bottom, large primary CTA

dashboard_home.layout: Bento grid style using Flexbox. Large Hero circular ring for Recovery Score. Smaller cards for Strain, Sleep, Stress.

metric_details.layout: Header with metric value. Large chart showing historical or intra-day trend. Breakdown list below.

types.sleep: Sleep Stages (Deep, REM, Light, Awake), Duration, Efficiency

history_trends.layout: Tab selector (Weekly/Monthly). Stacked charts or line charts comparing Strain vs Recovery.

ai_health_tips.layout: Chat-like or Insight-card layout. Focus on Claude-powered text blocks advising the user based on their data.

profile_settings.layout: List layout with distinct sections for connected devices, app units, and account management.

onboarding_background.description: a man standing on one leg in a gym, dark lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme, using #0A0A0A for main backgrounds to create an elite athletic vibe.
Use react-native-svg for all circular score rings and apply the corresponding neon accent colors.
Ensure all interactive components and key view elements receive a 'data-testid' for testing (e.g., 'dashboard-recovery-ring').
Implement device pairing simulations (Apple Watch & Xiaomi Mi Band 8) in the Onboarding flow.
Use standard React Native components; this is a mobile app, do NOT use HTML/CSS or Shadcn web components.
